data.notes: Dubai’s March 2026 music calendar was especially strong in the final week, with arena pop/hip-hop concerts, Dubai Opera recitals, and large-scale house bookings clustered around Eid and Dubai World Cup weekend.

events.title: Holi Sundowner 2026 – Festival of Colors
events.summary: Holi Sundowner returned to Dubai on 21 March with a color-festival format and a music lineup including Tushar, Opposite Dimension, Buddha, SIB, Sarpanch, AJee, Raahyl, Montz and AK.

events.title: Bohemia Presents Jan Blomqvist & Valeron
events.summary: Bohemia hosted a beachfront electronic night on 21 March with Jan Blomqvist and Valeron, pairing live melodic electronic performance with organic and Afro-house sounds.

events.title: Sonny Fodera | Playa Pacha
events.summary: Australian house headliner Sonny Fodera played Playa Pacha at FIVE LUXE JBR on 21 March, a one-night club booking from the Pacha ICONS ecosystem.

events.title: Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber
events.summary: Wu-Tang Clan brought The Final Chamber tour to Coca-Cola Arena on 22 March, billed as the group’s Dubai stop on its farewell-era international run.

events.title: Omid & Jamshid Live in Dubai
events.summary: Persian singers Omid and Jamshid performed together at Dubai Opera on 25 March, presented as a rare live collaboration for fans of Persian pop and ballads.

events.title: Yuja Wang – Piano Recital
events.summary: Internationally acclaimed pianist Yuja Wang appeared at Dubai Opera on 26 March for a solo piano recital presented by G42 and promoted by M Premiere.

events.title: Josh Groban: GEMS World Tour
events.summary: Josh Groban brought his GEMS World Tour to Coca-Cola Arena on 27 March, with Ticketmaster listing the Dubai concert at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Aghany Almosalsalat
events.summary: Aghany Almosalsalat ran at Dubai Opera on 27–28 March, presenting a live concert of beloved Arabic television theme songs and regional nostalgia.

events.title: Keinemusik | Pacha ICONS
events.summary: Pacha ICONS staged Keinemusik’s desert show at Bab Al Shams Arena on 28 March, with &ME, Rampa and Adam Port billed for the open-air late-night event.

events.title: A1 and Music Travel Love Live in Dubai
events.summary: Pop group A1 and acoustic duo Music Travel Love shared a one-night Coca-Cola Arena bill on 28 March, aimed at nostalgic pop and singalong audiences.

events.title: Jason Derulo at Dubai World Cup After-Race Concert
events.summary: Jason Derulo headlined the official after-race entertainment for the 30th Dubai World Cup at Meydan Racecourse on 28 March, closing the race-day programme with a pop concert.

events.title: Bohemia Presents Robin Schulz
events.summary: Robin Schulz played Bohemia Beach Club on 28 March, bringing his melodic house and pop-dance crossover sound to FIVE Palm’s beachfront venue.
